notes.title: Devlog #1 – Welcome to Alice - Island Adventure
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! 👋[/p][p]Thanks for stopping by and checking out the very first devlog for [i]Alice - Island Adventure[/i]!
This project has been a real passion of mine, and I’m excited to finally share some early insights with you.[/p][p][/p][p]In this game, you’ll follow Alice – a girl setting out on what was supposed to be a relaxing vacation. But things take an unexpected turn, ...and she soon finds herself in an unfamiliar place – beautiful, yet unsettling – where nothing is quite as it seems. As she searches for a way forward, strange encounters and a growing sense of doubt begin to blur the line between reality and imagination.[/p][p][/p][p]There’s still [b]a lot of work ahead[/b], but the game is slowly taking shape. I’ve already started polishing key elements of the experience to make it more immersive and visually engaging.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the recent additions: [b]short cinematic sequences[/b] that help bring the atmosphere and story moments to life. These cutscenes are designed to enhance the emotional tone and draw you deeper into Alice’s journey.[/p][previewyoutube="ujr2DtuHrK4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]At the same time, I’m currently working on a [b]demo version[/b] of the game, which will give you a chance to explore a slice of the adventure and get a first taste of the experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned – there’s much more to come, and I can’t wait to show you how [i]Alice - Island Adventure[/i] evolves in the weeks and months ahead![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support!
– Robin[/p]
